fields.name: Native Form
fields.description: The surface form in its native script. This is the inflected/conjugated form as it appears in actual usage.
fields.guidance: This should be the actual form as used in text, not the lemma base form. Examples: 'धावली' (she ran), 'धावतो' (he runs), 'जेवतो' (he eats). Maximum 255 characters.

fields.name: Form Type
fields.description: The grammatical category of this surface form. The form type determines whether features are available.
fields.guidance: Form type cannot be changed after creation. If you need a different type, create a new surface form instead. If your form type supports features, the Features section will appear below.

actions: Verify features are still appropriate if form type supports them
Update pronunciation if the form pronunciation has changed
Ensure the surface form still correctly links to the parent lemma
